title: CRC registry impact reference 1.0
description: Pinned recipe that resolves to a self-contained impact definition. reference_hash uses the definition canonicalization and hashing rules and is never embedded in the payload.

schema_version.x-crc-canonical: string preserved exactly; JSON escapes per the canonical profile

registry_id.x-crc-canonical: string preserved exactly; JSON escapes per the canonical profile

registry_revision.description: Pinned registry revision; never 'latest' by omission.
registry_revision.x-crc-canonical: string preserved exactly; JSON escapes per the canonical profile

registry_manifest_sha256.description: Digest of the pinned registry manifest; resolution rejects a different manifest.
registry_manifest_sha256.x-crc-canonical: string preserved exactly; JSON escapes per the canonical profile

resolver_semantics_version.description: Resolver semantics: override catalog, context precedence, fallbacks and key normalization.
resolver_semantics_version.x-crc-canonical: string preserved exactly; JSON escapes per the canonical profile

factor.x-crc-canonical: string preserved exactly; JSON escapes per the canonical profile

overrides.description: Typed overrides; absent keys use pinned registry defaults.
overrides.x-crc-canonical: object with sorted keys; absent keys omitted; always present in canonical form

context_defaults.x-crc-canonical: object with all members present; always present in canonical form

fallback_policy.description: error rejects missing table keys; legacy_defaults permits and records documented fallbacks.
fallback_policy.x-crc-canonical: string preserved exactly; JSON escapes per the canonical profile; always present in canonical form

identifier.description: Non-empty, case-sensitive string without surrounding whitespace.

number.description: JSON number converted once to finite IEEE binary64; booleans and strings are rejected.

sha256.description: Bare SHA-256 digest as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

content_hash.description: Prefixed content identity: sha256 of the canonical JSON bytes.

h3_cell.description: H3 cell index as 15 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

context.description: Registry resolution context. Every member is nullable and defaults to null; only context used by the resolved branch carries values in a frozen origin.

cell.description: H3 cell of the matched hazard row.
cell.x-crc-canonical: string preserved exactly; JSON escapes per the canonical profile; always present in canonical form

country.description: Country key, normalized only by the pinned registry manifest.
country.x-crc-canonical: string preserved exactly; JSON escapes per the canonical profile; always present in canonical form

continent.description: Continent key used by flood tables.
continent.x-crc-canonical: string preserved exactly; JSON escapes per the canonical profile; always present in canonical form

building_type.description: Building type key used by flood, SPEI and baseline-relative tables.
building_type.x-crc-canonical: string preserved exactly; JSON escapes per the canonical profile; always present in canonical form

historic_mean.description: Historical baseline exposure for baseline-relative factors.
historic_mean.x-crc-canonical: binary64 shortest round-trip number; negative zero emitted as 0.0; always present in canonical form

overrides.description: Typed registry overrides. Absent keys use the pinned registry default and are never materialized.

cooling_cost.description: Cooling cost for non-agricultural cooling-degree-days branches.
cooling_cost.x-crc-canonical: binary64 shortest round-trip number; negative zero emitted as 0.0; present only when supplied
cooling_cost.x-crc-absent: Absence is meaningful: the pinned registry default applies.

intercept.x-crc-canonical: binary64 shortest round-trip number; negative zero emitted as 0.0; present only when supplied
intercept.x-crc-absent: Absence is meaningful: the pinned registry default applies.

maximum_damage.description: Sigmoid upper curve level (offset + amplitude), hot-days upper clamp (nullable), or flood table scale factor.
maximum_damage.x-crc-canonical: binary64 shortest round-trip number; negative zero emitted as 0.0; present only when supplied
maximum_damage.x-crc-absent: Absence is meaningful: the pinned registry default applies.

midpoint.description: Sigmoid midpoint for sigmoid registry factors.
midpoint.x-crc-canonical: binary64 shortest round-trip number; negative zero emitted as 0.0; present only when supplied
midpoint.x-crc-absent: Absence is meaningful: the pinned registry default applies.

minimum_damage.description: Sigmoid lower curve level (maps to offset), or the hot-days lower clamp; null clears the hot-days clamp.
minimum_damage.x-crc-canonical: binary64 shortest round-trip number; negative zero emitted as 0.0; present only when supplied
minimum_damage.x-crc-absent: Absence is meaningful: the pinned registry default applies.

slope.x-crc-canonical: binary64 shortest round-trip number; negative zero emitted as 0.0; present only when supplied
slope.x-crc-absent: Absence is meaningful: the pinned registry default applies.

steepness.description: Sigmoid steepness for sigmoid registry factors.
steepness.x-crc-canonical: binary64 shortest round-trip number; negative zero emitted as 0.0; present only when supplied
steepness.x-crc-absent: Absence is meaningful: the pinned registry default applies.

water_unit_cost.x-crc-canonical: binary64 shortest round-trip number; negative zero emitted as 0.0; present only when supplied
water_unit_cost.x-crc-absent: Absence is meaningful: the pinned registry default applies.

zero_below.description: Strict sigmoid threshold below which the response is zero; null clears it.
zero_below.x-crc-canonical: binary64 shortest round-trip number; negative zero emitted as 0.0; present only when supplied
zero_below.x-crc-absent: Absence is meaningful: the pinned registry default applies.

x-crc-rules: Keys must be accepted for the selected factor (see catalogs/registry-overrides.json); otherwise inapplicable_override.
Explicit null is accepted only where the catalog marks the key nullable for the factor; otherwise invalid_value.
After context resolution, keys must also be accepted for the resolved branch.
